clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements of linoleum manufactured as sheets or tiles on a hessian backing and used as floor covering. Note  — This standard does not include jute canvas as backing material.

clauses.title: The wearing surface of the linoleum
clauses.text: 2.1 The wearing surface of the linoleum   shall be made from the following material: a) Oxidized or polymerized linseed oil (conforming to IS 75 : 1973) * or other suitable  drying oil, with  necessary driers; b) Rosin or resin or their combination: c) Cork flour or wood flour or both: d) Mineral fillers; and e) Colouring material or pigments Note —  The material shall be mixed and pressed to a specially smooth surface on the backing (see 2.2). The backing material shall be securely bonded to the wearing surface.

clauses.title: The type of hessian
clauses.text: 2.2 The type of hessian used for backing is dependent on the type of conform method of manufacture and the machine and for manufacture.

clauses.title: Plain Linoleum
clauses.text: 3.1 Plain Linoleum — The composition of plain linoleum shall be of uniform colour extending evenly throughout the full thickness from the wearing surface to the hessian backing.

clauses.title: Moire, Jaspe and Marble Linoleum
clauses.text: 3.2 Moire, Jaspe and Marble Linoleum — Linoleum other than plain shall be designed as in laid lislum. They are composed of different columns extendity from the wearing surface to the backing at random to form a variegated surface.

clauses.title: Sheets
clauses.text: 4.1.1 Sheets — Unless otherwise specified the linoleum sheets of all thickness shall be supplied in rolls of lengths not less than 5.0 m.The standard width of the sheets shall be 2.0 m.

clauses.title: Tiles
clauses.text: 4.1.2   Tiles — The size of tiles shall be 225, 300 and 450 mm square.

clauses.title: Thickness
clauses.text: 4.2 Thickness — The standard overall thickness of the linoleum tiles shall be 4.5 mm, 3.2 mm, 2.5 mm and 20 mm.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: 4.3 Tolerances — The tolerances on the specified width of sheets, tiles sizes and thickness shall be as given in Table 1.

clauses.title: Cork Tiles
clauses.text: 4.4 Cork Tiles — Cork tiles if supplied shall be of sizes and thickness as specified in  4.1.2 and 4.2 respectively. The permissible deviation in thickness shall be + 5 percent

clauses.title: Finish
clauses.text: 5. Finish —The wearing surface of linoleum shall be smooth, uniform and shall be free from indentations, cracks and protruding particles.

clauses.title: Packing
clauses.text: 7. Packing —The linoleum sheet shall be tightly wound on cores of mandrels of diameter not less than 75 mm. The rolls shall be wrapped in kraft paper (the weight of which shall not be less than 50 (g/m2) securely tied or otherwise fastend and finally packed in strong hessian or sacking.
